title: brisk host request
description: Printed on stdout by `brisk assess --backend host --format json`. The harness sends `state` and `questions` unchanged to its decision model (for Amp: amp.ai.decide({ model: 'typesafe/jev', state, questions })), then writes a host-answers document and runs `brisk assess --answers file.json` with the same other flags. `floor_assessment` is the rules-only result, to show when answering fails.

request_id.description: Hash of state, questions, review_questions, base commit, and the whole diff; copy it into the answers

model.description: Decision model the calibration expects, e.g. "typesafe/jev"

state.description: String or JSON object, at most 50,000 characters when serialised

review_questions.description: Optional. Score questions about the review plan's areas; answer them in a separate call on the same state and return them as review_answers. Absent when the plan is empty. The request_id covers them.

review_when.description: Present with review_questions. always: answer them with the main questions. recommended: answer them only if `brisk assess --answers` without review_answers gives agent_review.recommended, then run it again with review_answers.
